meta.title: Perspective & Spatial Perception
meta.subTitle: Perspective & Spatial Perception
meta.desc: Sharpen structural drawing intuition through Vanishing Point convergence, proportional division, Gestalt continuation, and 3D axonometric translation.

perspective_vp_convergence.title: VP Convergence
perspective_vp_convergence.desc: Modulate the ray angle to make it converge at the exact same vanishing point.
perspective_vp_convergence.instruction: Adjust the ray angle using the slider so all lines meet at the vanishing point.

perspective_proportion_division.title: Proportion Division
perspective_proportion_division.desc: Blindly cut lines at 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, or golden ratio (0.618).
perspective_proportion_division.instruction: Click at the designated target proportion along the tilted line.

perspective_proportion_migration.title: Proportion Migration
perspective_proportion_migration.desc: Migrate proportional divisions from horizontal references onto randomly tilted lines.
perspective_proportion_migration.instruction: Observe the target point above and mark the identical proportion below.

perspective_gestalt_continuation_2afc.title: Gestalt Continuation 2AFC
perspective_gestalt_continuation_2afc.desc: Identify the true collinear continuation penetrating an obstacle (2AFC).
perspective_gestalt_continuation_2afc.instruction: Select the line that maintains true collinear continuation (Keys 1 / 2).

perspective_structure_3d.title: 3D Structural Rotation
perspective_structure_3d.desc: Translate orthographic tri-views into 3D isometric cube grid coordinates.
perspective_structure_3d.instruction: Locate the 3D point in the axonometric cube grid based on the 3 views.

views.vpHint: Observe the existing perspective lines and adjust the slider to converge rays at the vanishing point (0°~360°)
views.proportionDivisionHint: Slide along the tilted segment and release to confirm proportional division (or click directly)
views.proportionMigrationHint: Observe the horizontal reference above and confirm the corresponding proportion on the tilted segment below
views.gestaltHint: Observe incoming line and identify the true collinear continuation penetrating the obstacle (Keys 1 / 2)
views.structureHint: Observe the tri-view coordinates and select the corresponding 3D vertex inside the isometric grid
